title: Delayed Graduation Ceremonies for ITE, Polytechnic and University Graduands Affected by COVID-19 Situation
what_it_is: Delayed Graduation Ceremonies for ITE, Polytechnic and University Graduands Affected by COVID-19 Situation

sections.label: IHL graduation ceremonies during COVID-19
sections.summary: IHLs cannot hold traditional graduation ceremonies this year and will explore other ways to help students celebrate when COVID-19 improves.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Education (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: Realistically, in the light of COVID-19 and the need for safe distancing measures, our IHLs will not be able to hold traditional graduation ceremonies this year.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Education (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: It will also not be practical to postpone these large-scale ceremonies later this year, even if it is safe to do so by then.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Education (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: Nonetheless, when the COVID-19 situation improves and stabilises, the IHLs will explore other ways, not involving big ceremonies, to help our students celebrate and commemorate the occasion, should they wish to.

sections.label: Graduation websites and virtual ceremonies
sections.summary: Polytechnics and ITEs have graduation websites and may allow gown rentals and campus photo-taking, while SMU will hold a virtual ceremony.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: Each of our Polytechnics and the ITEs have already set up a graduation website where congratulatory messages can be posted, in addition to the list of graduates and also the award winners.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: Having said that, the Polytechnics and the ITEs are considering to allow gown rentals for photo-taking and eventually the opening of campuses for photo-taking, as and when safe distancing measures are scaled back.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: As for our Autonomous Universities (AUs), as of now, SMU has decided that they will hold a virtual ceremony in place of the July ceremony.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: For the rest of the AUs, given that the graduation ceremonies are at least two to six months away, the other five AUs are deliberating the approaches and will certainly keep the graduands informed.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: For example, all the graduates graduating from ITEs, Polytechnics and AUs, will be offered complimentary access to pursue at least two CET modules and all our Education and Career Guidance (ECG) counsellors are available to support them in terms of career guidance and also career preparation.
